label: О нас
description: Prepositional sentences that train 'about us' after о/обо in real conversation.

missions.phrase: Соседи опять говорят о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Being discussed. 'О нас' is the prepositional form of мы after the preposition о, marking us as the topic. The plural verb 'говорят' here works like an impersonal 'people are talking', so the speaker stays unnamed.

missions.phrase: Интересно, что они думают о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Others' opinion. 'О нас' is the topic of their thoughts, in the prepositional case required by о. The embedded clause 'что они думают о нас' shows how the construction slots naturally into reported thought.

missions.phrase: Я всё время думаю о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Mental focus. The verb 'думать' takes о plus the prepositional case, so мы becomes 'нас'. 'Всё время' adds an everyday adverbial of frequency without touching the case of the pronoun.

missions.phrase: Он написал целую песню о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a work. Here 'о нас' modifies the noun 'песню', naming what the song is about. Prepositional complements with о attach to nouns just as easily as to verbs.

missions.phrase: Когда-нибудь напишут книгу о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Subject matter. 'О нас' tells us what the future book covers, staying in the prepositional case after о. The plural 'напишут' again reads as an impersonal 'someone will write'.

missions.phrase: Все на работе спрашивают о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite inquiry. 'Спрашивать о ком-то' uses о plus the prepositional case, so we appear as 'нас'. This is the everyday way to say people are asking after you.

missions.phrase: Здесь о нас никто не знает.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negative frame. Even under negation 'никто не знает', the prepositional 'о нас' keeps its form. The double negative никто... не is standard and obligatory in Russian.

missions.phrase: В этом городе все думают о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Broad subject. 'Все' gives a sweeping plural subject, while 'о нас' stays the fixed prepositional object of думать. The locative 'в этом городе' sets the scene without affecting the pronoun.

missions.phrase: Бабушка всегда заботится о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Care for someone. The verb 'заботиться' governs о plus the prepositional case, so мы becomes 'нас'. This is a warm, very common everyday pattern.

missions.phrase: Они уже всем рассказали о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past reporting. 'Рассказать о ком-то' keeps о plus the prepositional 'нас'. The past-tense 'рассказали' and the dative 'всем' surround the pronoun without changing its case.

missions.phrase: Скоро выйдет фильм о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a film. 'О нас' names what the film is about and modifies the noun 'фильм'. The construction is identical whether the work is a song, a book, or a movie.

missions.phrase: В газете вышла статья о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Written about us. 'О нас' is the prepositional complement of 'статья', naming its subject. Such phrases are everywhere in titles, bios, and the press.

missions.phrase: Они знают о нас слишком много.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Object of knowledge. 'Знать о ком-то' takes о plus the prepositional 'нас'. 'Слишком много' adds an everyday evaluation while the pronoun stays unchanged.

missions.phrase: В офисе мало говорят о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Quantity of talk. 'О нас' is the topic of 'говорят', held in the prepositional case by о. The quantifier 'мало' measures how much, not what case the pronoun takes.

missions.phrase: В деревне хорошо говорят о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Positive judgment. 'О нас' stays prepositional after о, while the adverb 'хорошо' colours how people speak. This is a natural way to report a good reputation.

missions.phrase: Мне интересно, что говорят о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative reaction plus reported speech. 'Мне интересно' frames the feeling with a dative experiencer, and the clause 'что говорят о нас' carries the prepositional pronoun. Two high-value structures combine in one line.

missions.phrase: Я помню, что говорили о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Memory of speech. The main verb 'помню' introduces a clause, and inside it 'о нас' stays prepositional after о. Past 'говорили' is impersonal plural.

missions.phrase: У них есть вопросы о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Noun complement. 'О нас' modifies the noun 'вопросы', naming their subject. The existential 'у них есть' provides a natural everyday frame.

missions.phrase: Соседи опять спорят о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dispute over a topic. 'Спорить о чём-то' takes о plus the prepositional case, so мы becomes 'нас'. The plural 'спорят' makes it sound like real social life.

missions.phrase: Я не хочу сейчас говорить о нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Refusal to discuss. 'О нас' stays prepositional after о even though the verb chain is 'не хочу говорить'. This stacking of a negated finite verb plus infinitive is very natural in conversation.
